cohort: 7248 women who delivered at a tertiary care center in Kadapa, India between June 2022 and June 2023.
finding: Of 87 PPH cases, 84 were due to atonic PPH, with most managed medically (53 cases) and the remaining 34 managed surgically using suction cannula.
mod_finding: Of the 34 women managed with suction cannula, 11 had vaginal deliveries and the rest had cesarean sections.
